Eternal Vigilance: Atlanta

02 September 2011, 19:00

Standard Constructed

Friday 9/02/11 Session 3 (7PM – 1AM) Eternal Vigilance: Atlanta. Vampire: The Eternal Struggle. Sanctioned Standard Constructed Tournament: 2 preliminary rounds (players play both rounds) and final round for the top 5 players. The event will be multi-judged and if there are 12 or less players this will be a multi-deck event (may change decks between each round). Booster packs and promos for all, additional prizes for the winner.

Dragon’s Breath: SE Regional Qualifier

04 September 2011, 12:00 – 20:00
National Qualifier

Sunday 9/04/11 Sessions 9 – 10 (Noon – 8PM) Dragon’s Breath: SE Regional Qualifier
Vampire: The Eternal Struggle. Qualifying Event for the North American Championship: 3 preliminary rounds (players play all rounds) and a final round for the top 5 players. Those players finishing in the top 25% are qualified to play in the North American Championship at Origins Game Fair in June 2012. Booster packs and promos for all, additional prizes for the winner.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: I understand this (and the Erie Con Qualifier) are qualifiers for the NAC 2012. But regarding the EC, is it a qualification tournament for the EC 2011 or 2012?

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
It is my understanding that any qualifier events after the championship for that continent count for the next years events for all continents.

This would be a good thing for the national volunteers and the chairman to decide and announce ASAP.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
So far, we secretly applied the same rule that was written for the winner of a 10+ player event:

The winner of a sanctioned, rated, standard constructed tournament of 10 or more players will be qualified for all Continental Championships for the calendar year of the upcoming championship in that tournament's continent.

Same applies for Continental Qualifiers.

Players qualifying at DragonCon 2011 and ErieCon 2011 will be qualified for the 2012 Continental Championships.
Also: players qualified at the NAC 2011's First Chance Qualifier are qualified for the 2012 Continental Championships.
